text: 治理中小企业回款顽疾！央行：大型企业压降账款可享债券融资便利 中小企业承担了大企业转嫁的融资成本，结构上错配也给货币政策传导造成不利影响。
text_en: Tackling the Chronic Problem of SME Payment Collection! PBOC: Large Enterprises That Reduce Payables Can Enjoy Bond Financing Facilitation. SMEs Bear the Financing Costs Passed on by Large Enterprises, and the Structural Mismatch Also Adversely Affects Monetary Policy Transmission.
